subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should automatic TTS fallback remain enabled when an explicitly configured provider fails, or should OpenClaw preserve voice identity by failing closed or requiring an explicit no-fallback mode?
rationale: Current docs and source intentionally fallback across configured speech providers, so changing this would alter provider-routing policy and upgrade behavior rather than being a narrow code-only repair.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep the current fallback default for now and request a redacted /tts status or log trace proving usable ElevenLabs audio was discarded before changing policy.

options.title: Add strict voice identity
options.body: Introduce or sponsor a narrow strict/no-fallback behavior for TTS paths where preserving the configured voice matters more than delivering any audio.

options.title: Keep fallback as designed
options.body: Close the remaining stickiness request after documenting that fallback to another configured provider is expected and diagnosable.

recommendation.title: Require live proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the current fallback default for now and request a redacted /tts status or log trace proving usable ElevenLabs audio was discarded before changing policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the recent partial fixes and explicitly scoped the remaining issue to provider stickiness or policy.
